rightsGate.rule: No asset may enter the final timeline unless provenance and usage rights are documented and approved.

qualityGate: Every factual visual maps to claim IDs and source records.
Charts reproduce source figures accurately and disclose calculations.
No stock footage is misrepresented as the company, location, event, or period.
Maps use verified boundaries and dated geographic context.
All images are sharp, correctly oriented, and appropriate to the stated period.
On-screen text is proofread and readable at mobile size.
warnings: This is a shot and asset acquisition plan, not a collection of acquired media.
No external assets were downloaded or licensed.
Shot durations are planning targets and must be conformed to final narration.
All rights and factual provenance require human approval.
